import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF1187G extends PrintWriter {
    public CF1187G() { super(System.out); }
    
    static class FastInput {
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 15];
        private int index, size;
        private final InputStream stream;
        
        FastInput(InputStream s) { stream = s; }
        
        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (index >= size) {
                size = stream.read(buffer);
                index = 0;
                if (size <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[index++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) <= 32) if (c == -1) return -1;
            int val = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return val;
        }
    }
    
    FastInput input;
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CF1187G solver = new CF1187G();
        solver.input = new FastInput(System.in);
        solver.run();
        solver.flush();
    }
    
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    List<Integer>[] graph;
    int nodeCount, edgeCount;
    int[] fromNode, toNode, xorValue;
    int[] edgeCap, origCost, reducedCost;
    int[] edgeFlow;
    
    void setup(int n, int m) {
        nodeCount = n;
        edgeCount = m;
        graph = new ArrayList[nodeCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        dist = new int[nodeCount];
        level = new int[nodeCount];
        fromNode = new int[edgeCount];
        toNode = new int[edgeCount];
        xorValue = new int[edgeCount];
        edgeCap = new int[edgeCount];
        origCost = new int[edgeCount];
        reducedCost = new int[edgeCount];
        edgeFlow = new int[edgeCount];
    }
    
    int[] dist, level;
    
    void insertEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost) {
        int idx = edgeCount++;
        fromNode[idx] = u;
        toNode[idx] = v;
        xorValue[idx] = u ^ v;
        origCost[idx] = cost;
        reducedCost[idx] = cost;
        edgeCap[idx] = capacity;
        edgeFlow[idx] = capacity;
        graph[u].add(idx);
        graph[v].add(idx ^ 1);
    }
    
    boolean findShortestDistances(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(level, 0);
        dist[source] = 0;
        
        PriorityQueue<int[]> queue = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> {
            if (a[0] != b[0]) return a[0] - b[0];
            return a[1] - b[1];
        });
        queue.add(new int[]{0, source});
        
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = queue.poll();
            int u = cur[1];
            int d = cur[0];
            
            if (d != dist[u]) continue;
            
            int nextLevel = level[u] + 1;
            
            for (int edge : graph[u]) {
                if (edgeCap[edge] <= 0) continue;
                int realEdge = edge >> 1;
                int cost = (edge & 1) == 0 ? reducedCost[realEdge] : -reducedCost[realEdge];
                int newDist = dist[u] + cost;
                int v = u ^ xorValue[realEdge];
                
                if (newDist < dist[v]) {
                    dist[v] = newDist;
                    level[v] = nextLevel;
                    queue.add(new int[]{newDist, v});
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != INF;
    }
    
    int push(int u, int sink, int flow) {
        if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        int nextLevel = level[u] + 1;
        
        for (int edge : graph[u]) {
            if (edgeCap[edge] <= 0) continue;
            int realEdge = edge >> 1;
            int cost = (edge & 1) == 0 ? reducedCost[realEdge] : -reducedCost[realEdge];
            int v = u ^ xorValue[realEdge];
            
            if (dist[v] == dist[u] + cost && level[v] == nextLevel) {
                int sent = push(v, sink, Math.min(flow, edgeCap[edge]));
                if (sent > 0) {
                    edgeCap[edge] -= sent;
                    edgeCap[edge ^ 1] += sent;
                    return sent;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    int compute(int source, int sink) {
        System.arraycopy(origCost, 0, reducedCost, 0, edgeCount);
        int totalCost = 0;
        
        while (findShortestDistances(source, sink)) {
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = push(source, sink, INF)) > 0) {
                totalCost += pushed * dist[sink];
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < edgeCount; i++) {
                int u = fromNode[i], v = toNode[i];
                if (dist[u] != INF && dist[v] != INF) {
                    reducedCost[i] += dist[u] - dist[v];
                }
            }
        }
        
        return totalCost;
    }
    
    void run() {
        try {
            int n = input.nextInt();
            int m = input.nextInt();
            int k = input.nextInt();
            int c = input.nextInt();
            int d = input.nextInt();
            
            int[] special = new int[k];
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) special[i] = input.nextInt() - 1;

                int v = input.nextInt() - 1;
                adj[u].add(v);
                adj[v].add(u);
            }
            
            int T = k + 1;
            int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
            int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
            setup(totalNodes, totalEdges);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            }
            
            int sink = 0 * T + T - 1;
            println(compute(source, sink));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
